recent_commits.message: Add an implementation status entry for wimsey (#296)
Remove Workload Identity Key Management section from WPT, which seems more appropriate in ietf-wimse-workload-creds where it already is (#300)
Try to be more clear on how the various token hash claims are done (#293)
Add WIT validation procedure for recipients (#291)
update example title to make it clear that  is an extension (#288)
Clarify WIT/PoP vs mutual TLS (do not delete the distinction) (#281)
State WIC revocation stance (short lifetime as mitigation) (#280)
Add wimse-sign-response for mandated signed responses (#278)
Regenerate HTTP signature examples with wimse-req-nonce. (#275)
Differentiate cloud provider credential from a workload identity (#78)
Reworked intro to remove normative language
Update organization for Joe Salowey to Palo Alto Networks
Trust domain is an opaque string
Sync up trust domain definition with architecture
Identifier on its own is not verifiable
Workload identifier is a full uri
separate recordings box a bit more
tweak CSS for boxes on main screen
make single recordings button with list
Improved landing page for the WIMSE project
